title: CALRK-Bench: Evaluating Context-Aware Legal Reasoning in Korean Law

model.params_source: paper Sec. 4.1 / Table 1 (GPT-5* (l) = reasoning effort low, three runs with a fixed seed via OpenRouter); seed value not printed, max_tokens assumed

task.subset_rule: all Type-ISR items (279 questions over the Sufficient / Insufficient / Partial conditions)
task.approximation: direct OpenAI API instead of OpenRouter; GPT-5 is not deterministic under a seed; the Korean prompt assembly (instruction, question, options) follows the repository items and the Appendix A.2.2 layout

items.license: unknown (no license file in the repository)

fields_paper.label: answer letter (key name unverified)
fields_paper.id: id (encodes case, condition and variant, e.g. 0_c1_s0_v0; condition key unverified)

prompt.source_location: Appendix A.2.2 (Type-ISR example, English translation of the Korean item: instruction, [Question], [Options] A)-D), 'You must output only one letter among A/B/C/D as the answer.')
prompt.verbatim: partial (the prompts are the released Korean items themselves; the paper prints translated examples only)

placeholders_paper.instruction: items.instruction (Korean; ends with the instruction to output only one of A/B/C/D)
placeholders_paper.question: items.question

output.parse_paper: letter (A-D): first standalone letter A-D in the reply

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: item-weighted accuracy over all 279 Type-ISR items, mean over the three runs; this equals the Table 1 'Avg' (the per-condition values 0.973 / 0.756 / 0.651 weighted by the condition sizes 49 / 123 / 107 give 0.754, whereas their plain mean is 0.793)
metric.original_location: Table 1, row GPT-5* (l), Type-ISR Avg (Suff. 0.973, Insuff. 0.756, Part. 0.651)
metric.definition_paper: accuracy per condition (Sufficient, Insufficient, Partial), averaged over the three conditions (Table 1 Type-ISR Avg), mean over the three runs

cost.prepare_note: runner --prepare --dry-run 2026-09-07 (chars/4 input tokens, max_tokens counted as output per call)

notes: Items carry statute texts (~1K tokens); ~$0.03 per gpt-5 call with low reasoning effort. The 'GPT-5* (m)' row (minimal effort, 0.762) is an alternative target. || [normalize 2026-09-07] calrk_type2.jsonl verified (279 rows; id, instruction, question, choices {A,B,C,D}, answer A-D, meta {case, variant, category}). Conditions: meta.category need_law = case 1 (123 rows, Insufficient), no_need_law = case 2 (49 rows, Sufficient), need_law_partial = case 3 (107 rows, Partial); 49 ids have no '_s' segment. The Table 1 Avg is reproduced exactly by item-weighted accuracy, so metric.name is 'accuracy' (was 'custom'). The runner sends reasoning_effort=low and max_completion_tokens=2048 for gpt-5 and drops temperature/top_p/seed.
